title: Loyalty points refund reversal
intent: Implement a refund function for paid orders. Refund amounts must be positive and cannot exceed the remaining paid amount. Successful refunds must update refunded_total. If the original order awarded loyalty points, the refunded portion must reverse the corresponding loyalty points from the customer's balance.
ai_generated_spec: Refund amounts must be positive and cannot exceed the remaining paid amount. Successful refunds update refunded_total.
critic_improved_spec: Refund amounts must be positive and cannot exceed the remaining paid amount. Only paid orders can be refunded. Successful refunds must update refunded_total and cannot exceed the original payment.
full_oracle_spec: Refund amounts must be positive and cannot exceed the remaining paid amount. Only paid orders can be refunded. Successful refunds must update refunded_total. If the original order awarded loyalty points, the refunded portion must reverse the corresponding loyalty points from the customer balance, without making loyalty points negative.
missing_requirements: Successful refunds must reverse proportional loyalty points awarded by the original purchase
Loyalty points must not become negative
Cancelled or chargeback orders cannot be refunded
Refund cannot exceed remaining paid amount
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select refund code that updates refunded_total but fails to reverse loyalty points.
expected_defense: A checklist critic can still miss organization-specific loyalty side effects; the full oracle spec should catch them.
